items.item_text: Required to hold a valid California driver's license, have a driving record that is in accordance with local policies/procedures, and/or enroll in the California Employer Pull Notice Program
High school diploma or equivalent work experience and/or training
Associate's or Bachelor's in a Science field.
Experience in an Anatomic Pathology Laboratory setting (e.g. Histology, Grossing, Cytology)

This position supports the Department by providing timely and accurate specimen receipt, accessioning, preparation, and/or processing for analysis on various tissue and body fluids. Functions also include delivering specimen collection information and results to doctors, ensuring accurate chain of custody documentation glassware, equipment and general area maintenance.
Manual dexterity for pipetting specimens and operating automated equipment.
Possession of technical vocabulary to meet departmental business needs.
Manual dexterity for cleaning automated equipment.
Adhere to UCDHS and Department of Pathology guidelines concerning rules of conduct, safety, and all applicable policies, procedures, and protocols.
Endurance to work extra hours in the event of an emergency.
Possess tact and diplomacy to effectively deal with ward, clinic, laboratory personnel and individuals outside of the hospital environment in a professional and courteous manner.
Vision for reading thermometers, charts, and finely ruled divisions.
Display respect and maintain the confidentiality of all patients, physicians, and hospital-related information.
Must possess working knowledge of laboratory protocols and skill in the application of such.
Possess mathematic skills for performing routine laboratory calculations.
Must possess working knowledge of medical terminology, basic human anatomy and technical knowledge to complete assigned tasks.
Knowledge of basic chemistry and biology for understanding methods used in the laboratory.
Reading skills to understand procedures, protocols, and policies.
Ability to prioritize work and several projects/tasks simultaneously and complete work/projects/tasks in a timely manner.
Ability during changing demands, to assess work volume accurately and quickly as needed to meet business commitments.
Ability to maintain composure and flexibility in an evolving environment.
Ability to maintain records legibly and accurately.
Ability to follow written and verbal instructions.
Possess skill to communicate and function effectively in a diverse and multi cultural work environment.
Knowledge and ability to operate a personal computer.
Ability to write numbers and letters legibly.
Ability to work as a member of a team and to assist colleagues as needed.
Skills to operate office equipment.
